expectations.name: tenant_isolation_principal_only
expectations.intent: Tenant isolation in principal_only: every accepted resource operation should have originatingCustomer equal to resourceOwner. The described setup suggests this safety property is violated because Mallory can request Alice's role and no external-ID condition is imposed.

expectations.name: tenant_isolation_caller_supplied
expectations.intent: Tenant isolation in caller_supplied: every accepted resource operation should have originatingCustomer equal to resourceOwner. The described setup suggests this safety property is violated because Mallory knows Alice's external ID and may supply it with Alice's role identifier.

expectations.name: tenant_isolation_provider_bound
expectations.intent: Tenant isolation in provider_bound: every accepted resource operation should have originatingCustomer equal to resourceOwner, because the provider uses the trusted external-ID mapping for the authenticated originating customer rather than the caller-supplied field.

expectations.name: mallory_can_access_alice_resource_principal_only
expectations.intent: Attack reachability in principal_only: determine whether a Mallory-originated job can cause an operation on Alice's resource.

expectations.name: mallory_can_access_alice_resource_caller_supplied
expectations.intent: Attack reachability in caller_supplied: determine whether a Mallory-originated job can cause an operation on Alice's resource.

expectations.name: mallory_can_access_alice_resource_provider_bound
expectations.intent: Attack reachability in provider_bound: determine whether a Mallory-originated job can cause an operation on Alice's resource. The described setup suggests this trace should not exist.

expectations.name: alice_legitimate_job_principal_only_executable
expectations.intent: Executability: Alice can complete a legitimate job on her own resource in principal_only; rejecting all jobs is not an acceptable repair.

expectations.name: alice_legitimate_job_caller_supplied_executable
expectations.intent: Executability: Alice can complete a legitimate job on her own resource in caller_supplied; rejecting all jobs is not an acceptable repair.

expectations.name: alice_legitimate_job_provider_bound_executable
expectations.intent: Executability: Alice can complete a legitimate job on her own resource in provider_bound; rejecting all jobs is not an acceptable repair.
